eyebrow: TELVERGENCE × Miami Realty Group · Residential · Commercial · Investment
h1b: We make it ring to you.
tagline: In real estate the lead has a shelf life measured in minutes — a buyer inquiring on a listing calls the next agent if you don't pick up. We turn this brokerage into a 10-line Smart-DID grid where every listing, buyer, seller, and investor call is answered instantly, in the caller's language, and routed to the right agent on floor — with every source measured to the dollar.
demoNote: Miami brokerage campaign · listings · buyers · sellers · investors · rentals · 10-line pack · numbers pending assignment
insight: a single Miami transaction pays a $9,000–$60,000+ commission — and the industry's own data is brutal: the agent who responds first wins the overwhelming majority of inquiries. Every listing sign, portal lead, and open-house card produces calls at unpredictable hours, and an agent showing property cannot answer them. A phone number that just rings can't. A Smart DID can.

dids.p: Priority ring, never voicemail — the brokerage's front door.
Routes Spanish callers to a bilingual agent path — essential in this market.
The international buyer segment most brokerages cannot answer.
The sign-call line — tagged to the listing so you know which property produced it.
The listing-appointment line — your highest-value inbound call.
Cash and portfolio buyers routed to the agents who handle them.
Separated from residential so commercial inquiries never sit in a retail queue.
High-volume, low-ticket calls kept off the sales lines.
Proves portal ROI to the dollar — swap the number, keep the data.
The dialer's outbound face — branded, compliant, recorded.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer works expired listings, FSBOs, and farm areas — branded caller-ID, compliant scripting, recordings, callbacks. Every call is DNC-scrubbed before the list ever runs.
10 tracked lines + 24/7 AI answer + SMS. Every listing source measured, floor-duty rotation honored, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, appointments set, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which listing and which portal produced which closing.

commandCenter.h2: Your live command center — pipeline in real time
commandCenter.note: Every call feeds a real-time conduit your customized "second brain" analyzes on the fly — then you, or the AI, adjust the leads, script, offer, farm area, or channel instantly and watch the pipeline move. Your agents close — we make the phone ring.

map.title: Miami market area
map.note: Every Smart DID is geo-aware: inbound calls are tagged by listing and ZIP and routed to the agent on floor duty for that area — and outbound farming targets the exact neighborhoods you want to own.

videoSub: A typical brokerage site vs. the offspring · the 10-line grid · a listing appointment set in 90 seconds. (Embed final MP4 / YouTube here.)
offerLead: We stand up all ten numbers, the AI answer, the bilingual routes, floor-duty rotation, and a starter outbound farming campaign across your target neighborhoods. For 30 days every inbound inquiry is answered and routed while the dialer works your farm.
alternative: pass, and the next buyer inquiry goes to the brokerage down Brickell — who answers in ten seconds while your agent is at a showing. Territories are exclusive and claimed once.
